trigger: Both isolated CSC B kernels failed. Before constructing A, identify which state coordinates limit the adaptive CNS timestep instead of assigning slow/fast regions by anatomical story.
question: Across every actual CNS trial in one real1-ms sham organism, which coordinate attains the max accepted-error norm, at what h, and how concentrated are those limiting coordinates?
stop_rule: One read-only instrumented organism run. If actual error norm cannot be reconstructed from block maxima, reject interpretation. No timestep or tolerance changes.
interpretation: A diagnostic of the current integrator. Concentrated limiter can motivate an exact/implicit treatment and a prospective state-error test; distributed limiter weakens simple local-stiffness designs. No speed claim.
